modifications.description: Initial accommodation research for 15-day China trip: Beijing (Saga Hostel + Leo Hostel), Datong (City Comfort Inn), Chengdu (Mix Hostel), Xi'an (Shuyuan Hostel), Shanghai (Captain Hostel)
Initial entertainment research for 15-day China trip (Beijing, Datong, Chengdu, Xi'an, Shanghai) - added evening activities for 13 of 15 days

Added inter-city transportation for all location change days: Day 3 (Beijing->Datong HSR), Day 4 (Datong->Beijing HSR return), Day 5 (Matilde: Beijing->Chengdu flight), Day 6 (Jade: Beijing->Chengdu flight), Day 8 (Jade: Chengdu->Beijing flight), Day 9 (Chengdu->Xian HSR), Day 12 (Matilde: Xian->Shanghai flight; Jade: Beijing->Shanghai flight), Day 14 (Shanghai->Beijing HSR)

Added shopping POIs for 15-day China trip: Qianmen/Dashilar (Day 1 Beijing), Weidu Antique City (Day 4 Datong), Jinli Ancient Street (Day 5 Chengdu), Kuanzhai Xiangzi (Day 7 Chengdu), Muslim Quarter (Day 10 Xi'an), Shuyuan Men (Day 11 Xi'an), Yu Garden Bazaar + Tianzifang + Nanjing Road area (Day 13 Shanghai), Wangfujing (Day 14 Beijing)
